geisel.source_note: FGV CPDOC documents the public Accessus archive for the Geisel collection. The STM catalogue describes a Geisel collection photograph with Agency Nacional stamp.
geisel.rights_note: No retrievable image with a reuse licence established in this audit.

sandra_cavalcanti.source_note: The Câmara archive has an exact-name authority record and 1987-1988 audiovisual records; no downloadable still portrait was identified.
sandra_cavalcanti.rights_note: The Câmara states its 1960-2002 photo archive may be reused under CC BY with credit, but no matching standalone image asset was captured.

sarney.source_note: Museu da República describes 1985 photographs including an official portrait with presidential sash and a first press conference; Senate Museum catalogues a Sarney portrait.
sarney.rights_note: Image-specific reproduction terms were not established; no files were copied.

maluf.source_note: The Chamber has an exact-name biography image and an official archive photo from the 1985 electoral college showing Maluf and Tancredo in the historical event.
maluf.rights_note: The historical photo archive is CC BY, with required credit. The current profile image's reuse terms were not confirmed; no image was copied.

ulysses_guimaraes.source_note: The Câmara hosts an exact-name photograph credited to Orlando Brito and several official 1987-1988 parliamentary photos.
ulysses_guimaraes.rights_note: The Câmara's 1960-2002 photo archive is CC BY with photographer credit. The Orlando Brito exhibit image is credited to a personal archive and its reuse terms are not stated; no image was copied.

tancredo_neves.source_note: Câmara's official history page includes the 1985 electoral-college image; its repository also offers a biographical volume with photographs.
tancredo_neves.rights_note: The Câmara historical photo archive is CC BY with credit. The biographical book contains item-specific materials whose separate photo rights were not established; no image was copied.

goulart.source_note: Museu da República catalogue describes five exact-person image items, including presidential portraits from 1961-1964. CPDOC lists a João Goulart archive.
goulart.rights_note: The catalogue identifies the images but no image-specific reuse permission was established; no files were copied.

ivete_vargas.source_note: The Biblioteca Nacional Hemeroteca contains period newspaper and magazine scans with photographs of Ivete Vargas, including a 1979 interview feature.
ivete_vargas.rights_note: Publication and photograph rights for the scanned press images are not established; no files were copied.

brizola.source_note: FGV CPDOC provides an exact-person biography; the Câmara archive includes exact-person political records from the Constituent Assembly period.
brizola.rights_note: No image-specific licence was established for a usable portrait; no files were copied.

amazonas.source_note: The Chamber biography page carries an exact-person image; its official biographical volume includes photographs.
amazonas.rights_note: The Chamber volume's item-specific licence or photo rights were not established for reuse; no image was copied.

collor.source_note: The Câmara archive identifies two 1987 photographic-negative collections for Collor. The audit did not establish a direct downloadable portrait file.
collor.rights_note: Câmara's 1960-2002 photo archive is CC BY with credit, but the exact relevant image was not retrieved; no image was copied.

policy: Do not substitute another person, reuse an unlicensed candidate image, or generate a historical-looking portrait. Missing assets stay explicitly unresolved until a suitable source file and reuse terms are verified.

fallback_recommendation.visual_inspection: Neutral bust silhouette with explicit NO PHOTOGRAPH label; no facial features or implied historical identity.

fallback_recommendation.recommendation: Use this exact image path for unresolved leader portraits instead of a portrait of a different person or a generated historical likeness.
